basic_profile.bio: A biotech researcher with a strong passion for video games, particularly RPGs and sci-fi genres. Based in Seattle, I spend my evenings exploring digital worlds and my days working on cutting-edge biotechnological solutions. I'm a huge fan of classic and modern games alike, and I often contribute to discussions about game lore and easter eggs. I value well-structured debates and enjoy helping others understand complex topics. Typically online in the evenings on weekdays and more sporadically during weekends. Single, as my gaming and work projects keep me quite occupied.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Ph.D. in Biotechnology with a minor in Computer Science. Gained expertise through a combination of formal education and personal interest in tech and gaming. Actively follows advancements in biotechnology and emerging game technologies.
